KahlWax 6607L MB Sunflower

KahlWax 6607L MB Sunflower is a light-colored wax derived as a by-product of milling unhulled sunflower seeds for edible oil. It is peroxide-free with a transparent melt due to a specialized production process. This wax offers a balanced softness-hardness ratio, excellent oil-binding capacity, and broad compatibility with polar and non-polar emollients. In anhydrous formulations, it forms hard, stable networks with high surface gloss, improves heat stability, and reduces stickiness. This product is certified RSPO Mass Balance quality.

The materials provided at this site are provided "as is" without any warranties of any kind including warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose or of any other nature regarding the information presented in this site, or non-infringement of intellectual property.

INCI Name: Ascorbyl Palmitate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Tocopherol

Labeling Claims: Peroxide-free, Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC)-free

Country Availability: Canada, USA
